chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzan, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

A man complained to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the pain he was experiencing in his loins. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'What is preventing you from eating what falls from the food-spread?'

key_terms.الْخَاصِرَةِ: The loins or lower back region

ai.seo_question: What is the remedy for waist pain according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, a man complains to Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) about pain in his loins (khāṣira), to which the Imam advises him to eat what falls from the food-spread (al-khwān). While some scholars interpret this as a specific medicinal remedy for lumbar pain, others view it as a general recommendation to avoid waste and consume permissible food that has fallen, reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical health advice intertwined with daily habits.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> what I faced from the waist pain. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is preventing you from eating what falls from the food-spread’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from Ibrahim ibn Mehzam who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
once a man complained before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, against his lower back pain. He (the Imam) said, ‘Why do you not eat pieces of food that fall on the table-spread/”
